trainer/31316.htm.text: Blacksmith Vincenz: Welcome! Welcome to the forge! We have a proud history and culture! Do you have anything that you like to craft? We can make anything here! Order whatever you like, from a noble woman's accessory to a war golem!

links.text: Bestow special ability on a weapon
View information about the lord and tax rate

trainer/31316-4.htm.text: Blacksmith Vincenz: You say you wish to remove the seal on an armor? Leave it to me!

links.text: Release seal on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on A-grade armor.

trainer/31316-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Vincenz: Lately, customers have become very interested in item augmenting. I have a lot of experience with the process, so you don't have to worry about the product's quality.

trainer/31316-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Vincenz: You're intrigued by Dwarven technology, aren't you? Only Artisans and Warsmiths may learn our secrets! Even non-Dwarves can understand the skills that I teach when they earn the title of Warsmith from the Head Blacksmith.

common/duals_03.htm.text: Ah! You wish to have a Dualsword made? That is our specialty! In fact, we can make every type of Dualsword except the A-grade! If there's anyone better than us, it could only be the legendary Blacksmith of Mammon ! You don't have to bring me a stamp, either. Just bring me the swords you want combin…

common/weapon_sa_01.htm.text: Ah, so you wish to enhance your weapon! Well, it's the next-best thing to buying a new one, I say... But remember, a higher price doesn't necessarily mean a better product. There are many excellent weapons that are reasonably priced. As I'm sure you know, capabilities added to your weapon don't int…

common/crafting_01.htm.text: [Create ingredient item] Our Blacksmith Guild creates items at a very reasonable price. You may entrust your precious materials to our Blacksmiths. They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

common/augmentation_01.htm.text: Augmenting means give energy to weapons or accessories. Augmenting is simple, but it isn't always accurate. A few days ago, a mysterious ore called Life Stone, which has a very similar characteristic to Soul Crystals, was found in Black Anvil. If you bring this Life Stone and some other necessities…

links.text: Exchange Life Stone for augmenting accesorries.

common/augmentation_02.htm.text: You wish to remove the refined Life Stone? That's fine. But understand that this smelting method offers both improvement and potential penalties. It is difficult to restore the original weapon when removing the Life Stone. It requires a special chemical process and a special tool. It's also expensi…

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
